ANC4 Coverage by District

Antenatal checkup coverage — share of registered pregnancies that completed 4+ antenatal visits (ANC4)

Select a year to compare districts

Pick a year — the chart and table update to compare all districts for that year.

Coverage by district

ANC4 coverage rate (%), ordered highest to lowest. Scale is 0–100%.

Underlying data

Raw counts behind the chart. Trend column shows the rate in each of the four years (highlighted = selected).

District Pregnancies registered Completed ANC4 ANC4 coverage Trend (2020→2023)

Data source

Where these numbers come from.

    How the rate is calculated

    The method behind every bar in this page.

    ANC4 coverage (%) = ANC4 completed ÷ Pregnancies registered × 100
    • ANC4 completed — pregnant women who completed 4 or more antenatal checkups (visits) during the year.
    • Pregnancies registered — all pregnancies registered at the facility in that district and year (the denominator).
    • The rate is computed per district per year from the counts above; the state total is the sum of completions divided by the sum of registrations (not an average of district rates).
